meta_description: Real band jumps from Bloom students, with certificates, testimonials and the measured outcomes behind them. 92% of students reach their target band.

props.heading: Where they started, and where they got to.
props.lead: Every band here was verified against an official test result. We do not publish an outcome we have not seen the certificate for.

students.name: Priya Sharma
students.quote: I had taken IELTS twice and got 6.0 for writing both times without ever understanding why. Bloom marked my first essay against the four criteria and the problem was obvious in ten minutes.

students.name: Li Chen
students.quote: My reading comprehension was fine — I just never finished the paper. James timed my skim and taught me to locate rather than read. That single change was worth a band.

students.name: Aisha Khan
students.quote: I needed 7.0 in every band for nursing registration and speaking was holding me back. Michael showed me I was stopping at seventy seconds in Part 2.

students.name: Nguyen Tran
students.quote: Nobody had ever told me that Vietnamese speakers drop final consonants, and that it reads as a grammar error rather than an accent. Once I knew, I could hear it.

students.name: Yusuf Demir
students.quote: I stopped deciding what to study every morning and just did what the plan said. Thirty-four day streak, and my mock scores went up every fortnight.

students.name: Fatima Ahmed
students.quote: I started at B1 and thought Band 7 was years away. The placement test said eighteen weeks. Having a real number instead of encouragement kept me going.

props.heading: Find out what band you would get today.
props.body: Twenty-five minutes, six parts, and a real CEFR level at the end of it. Free, and yours whether you enrol or not.
